description.value: Bottoms Bar & Grill is a classic ski-hill saloon positioned in the heart of Sun Peaks village, billing itself as 'the locals' living room.' The bar leans into old-school mountain culture with craft beers, big cocktails, and hearty food — a natural gathering spot for anyone arriving by trail or road after a day in the hills.
